author: worker_1
belief: Babur was not only a soldier; he was also a poet, diarist, statesman, and the founder/first Emperor of the Mughal Empire.

author: worker_1
belief: Babur successfully claimed and ruled land, including Fergana (initially), Kabul, and the Mughal Empire in Northern India.

author: worker_2
belief: Babur successfully conquered and claimed multiple territories: Fergana (ascended throne at age 12 in 1494), Samarkand (conquered multiple times), Kabul (conquered in 1504), and Northern India (defeated Ibrahim Lodi at First Battle of Panipat in 1526, founding the Mughal Empire). He ruled as emperor from 1526-1530.
